subject: MdeModulePkg/Core: Make PPI services spec complaint
reasons: The same allocation-failure pattern is repeated three times in the same file.
The before/after shape is explicit: preserve the `ASSERT` and add an `EFI_OUT_OF_RESOURCES` return path when allocation fails.
That makes this a mechanical collateral-evolution style change.
candidate_pattern: Replace `ASSERT (TempPtr != NULL);` in the PPI list growth paths with an `if (TempPtr == NULL)` block that asserts and returns `EFI_OUT_OF_RESOURCES`.
